result.topic_en: Notes on collecting guiding ideas (principle of uniqueness, necessary and sufficient conditions, group concept), a warning against overvaluing the modern relative to the past, and remarks on the history of the continuum from the ancients to its axiomatic treatment (Bolzano), followed by the start of a remark about his lectures.
